probing_questions: Which people, organizations, artifacts and inscriptions have an evidenced role in the arrangement?
How are participants or artifacts recruited, aligned or linked to make the arrangement work?
What does a device, document or institutional procedure change in what other actors can do?
What makes the arrangement durable or apparently routine, and where does it depend on maintenance or control?
Which controversies or refusals expose how the arrangement is assembled and could change?

problematique: An assembly inventory of people, organizations, artifacts and inscriptions with their supported roles, plus a mediation/enrollment/contestation table that distinguishes a working arrangement from a proposed or incomplete one. Accounts of actors, artifacts, inscriptions, institutions and their observable enrollment or mediation.
researcher_question: How does the supplied account assemble people, artifacts and inscriptions into a working arrangement?
